question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'moved to'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the given blank is** 'moved to'.**
 
• It means 'a change in the place where you live or work'. (निवास-स्‍थान या कार्य-स्‍थान में परिवर्तन)
 
 
• *Example: People are having to **move to **other areas in pursuit of work.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is** Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *I studied at the J.J. School of Art in Mumbai, India’s premier institute __of__ (1) art and design. After two years I __**moved to**__ (2) New York City to further my studies. I soon (3)______ myself in a totally different culture which I embraced (4)______ willingly. Interestingly, it was in New York that I began (5)______ different cuisines. *
